policies.n: German ordinary passport: obtain an entry visa before travel; the Foreign Office expressly identifies online eVisa application and the Berlin embassy channel. Stay is not specified. Passport must be valid at least six months and have six free pages according to this nationality-specific advice.

Dutch passport: visa required, with online application through the South Sudan government. Stay is not specified; passport must be valid at least six months on arrival. The same passport and visa requirements apply to children.

Czech passport: obtain a tourist eVisa in advance or a passport visa from the South Sudan embassy in Berlin; airport applications are not available under this advice. Print the approved electronic visa. The stated up-to-six-month period is visa validity, not a proved stay allowance.
Moldovan ordinary passport: visa required; the MFA identifies eVisa as the application method. The inspected row does not specify a tourist stay.

Mongolian ordinary passport: a visa is required under the MFA’s explicit residual rule. Electronic eligibility and tourist stay are not established by this table; this is not a claim that eVisa is unavailable.

Macao SAR passport: the DSI country-specific policy records no visa-free or arrival concession and identifies the South Sudan government eVisa channel. Obtain approval before travel; no stay is specified. This passport-specific record is not a mainland-China rule.

Federal Iraq: an entry visa is required under Article 3 of Law 76/2017 for ordinary foreign visitors outside its exemptions. Article 1 excludes Iraqis and their children carrying foreign passports and certain treaty/border/transport cases; those conditions are not assumed. The current London mission directs applications to evisa.iq, but this record does not establish this nationality’s electronic eligibility, issuance or product-specific stay. The statutory tourist product has a 30-day stay and 60-day entry validity; neither is assigned to an unconfirmed product. Kurdistan has a separate permission regime: its visa is not federal permission. KRI exempts documented Iraqi birthplace and may otherwise require a nationality-dependent guarantor. A visa requirement is not guaranteed tourist issuance or admission.
policies.label: Federal visa required; KRI permission separate

policies.n: Moldovan ordinary passport: the MFA expressly requires a visa and identifies the federal Iraq eVisa method. Stay is not specified. A Kurdistan-only permit does not authorize travel elsewhere in Iraq; regional rules and federal exemptions for Iraqis and their children holding foreign passports are separate.

Macao SAR passport: DSI identifies the federal evisa.iq channel and no ordinary visa-free/arrival concession; federal law requires a visa outside its exceptions. Tourist stay is not established. A Kurdistan-only permission is separate and is not authorization to enter other regions of Iraq; Iraqi parentage/birthplace exceptions require proof and are not assumed.

UAE ordinary passport: federal electronic visa, initial stay 30 days with a possible further 30-day extension for an additional fee. UAE MFA separately prohibits UAE citizens from travelling to Iraq; this outbound restriction is not an Iraqi nationality-wide admission ban. KRI-only permission is distinct from federal permission.

Moldovan ordinary passport: visa required without an applicable exemption. The MFA identifies eVisa; SMF conditions its advance entry-authorisation/border-visa procedure on coming from an area without Sao Tome consular representation. That residence/routing condition is not assumed. Portugal MFA separately documents a waiver for holders of a valid US or Schengen visa for up to two weeks; no such visa is assumed. SMF also exempts foreign spouses and accompanying descendants of Sao Tome citizens with the specified passport and civil-status proof. Seven working days is processing time, not stay; the visa branch’s stay is unspecified.
policies.label: Visa required; document and routing branches

policies.n: Mongolian ordinary passport: visa required under the MFA’s explicit residual rule. Current electronic/consular eligibility and stay remain unspecified; no third-country visa, residence or Sao Tome family exemption is assumed.

Macao SAR passport: DSI records no ordinary visa-free or walk-up arrival concession and identifies eVisaST. SMF’s advance entry-authorisation/border-visa branch depends on coming from an area without a Sao Tome mission. Portugal MFA separately documents a waiver for valid US/Schengen visa holders for up to two weeks; SMF documents a foreign-spouse/accompanying-descendant exemption with passport and civil-status proof. None of these routing, document or family conditions is assumed. Visa-branch stay is unspecified; seven working days is a response period.
policies.label: Visa required; document and routing branches

policies.n: Czech ordinary passport: visa-free for a stay not exceeding 15 days without gainful activity. Longer stays or paid activity require the appropriate visa.

Taiwan ordinary passport: BOCA expressly permits visa on arrival for up to 90 days. Carry a passport valid at least six months, return ticket, accommodation/contact details, at least two passport photos, yellow-fever vaccination certificate and proof of funds. This is Taiwan-specific evidence and does not establish eVisa eligibility.

Nicaraguan ordinary passport: the central guidelines’ explicit ordinary-tourist visa requirement applies outside the published exemption categories. Nicaragua is absent from the electronic/arrival nationality roster, so the usable issuance method remains unconfirmed; this does not mean eVisa is unavailable. No stay is assigned from the separate 90-day visa-validity field.

Belarusian ordinary passport: visa required. Czech missions do not ordinarily accept tourism applications under the published restrictions; specified close EU-family, qualifying scholarship and other exceptional applications are separate and are not assumed. This requirement-only record does not assert ordinary tourist issuance, nor establish admission through any particular Schengen border or with another state’s visa.
policies.label: Visa required; Czech tourist issuance restricted

policies.n: Russian ordinary passport: visa required and Czech tourism applications are ordinarily inadmissible outside the published exceptional categories. Non-biometric Russian passports are not recognised except for under-15 holders and applicants/holders of permission issued in Czechia’s interest. A valid visa alone is not permission to travel: external-border restrictions and the actual itinerary require separate clearance. No internal-Schengen tourist permission or nationality-wide entry ban is asserted.
policies.label: Visa and document restrictions; no routine tourist issuance

policies.n: Somali nationals require a visa, but Czechia does not recognise the Somali ordinary passport in the current EU document matrix. This is a qualified visa/document-authorisation requirement, not confirmation of a usable ordinary-passport tourist route. Any exceptional document or territorial permission must be established separately; issuance/admission is not assured. The current Somali visa measure normally permits only single-entry visas and extends processing to 45 days; 45 days is not the permitted stay.
policies.label: Visa required; ordinary passport not recognised

policies.n: Macao SAR passport: visa required under the destination’s non-exempt-visitor rule and the DSI passport-specific policy record. DSI identifies an eVisa channel but expressly warns that Macao visa-policy adjustments are under review; current electronic issuance and the residual 30-day field are not certified here. Obtain confirmation before departure. This record does not assert walk-up arrival permission or that eVisa is unavailable.
policies.label: Visa required; Macao method under official review

policies.n: Russian ordinary passport: visa required, but a Schengen tourist visa is not sufficient assurance of entry. Immigration Regulations section 19A-4b specifically permits rejection for tourism or other non-essential travel at Norway’s external Schengen border on foreign-policy grounds. The scope is external-border entry, not a nationality-wide prohibition everywhere. Eligibility for exceptions, actual visa issuance and any internal-Schengen itinerary must be determined separately; none is presumed.
policies.label: Visa required; external-border tourist restriction

policies.n: UAE ordinary passport: visa-free under the first group in Costa Rica’s published November 2025 directive, with a border-officer-granted stay up to 180 calendar days, no longer than passport validity. Carry a valid machine-readable or biometric passport, onward/return transport and funds of at least USD100 per month or fraction. This operative directive resolves the older conflicting mission table; 180 days is a ceiling, not guaranteed admission for that period.

Current London mission operational instructions and the KRI source were reconciled. 147 additions establish only the federal requirement; AE, MD and MO have narrower electronic-method evidence.
